g.text: 51 base histories · 10 corrupted trials per history · 5 matched seeds · each seed contributes equally

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #233746

g.text: Thin lines / dots: seed means. Thick lines: mean across seeds. References in panel A are from the same checkpoint.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #233746

g.text: “Other history” is the strongest-overlapping competitor among the same 51 base histories. Exact equality defines a collision.
